title: Admin
notAdmin: Only the instance admin can open this page.
loadFailed: Could not load this section. Reload the page to try again.
invitesIntro: On an invite-only server, people need an invite link to create an account. A link is shown only once, when you create it.
inviteEmailHint: Leave empty for a link anyone can use. With an email, the invite works once, for that email only.
createFailed: Could not create the invite. Check the form and try again.
linkShownOnce: Invite created. Copy the link now: it won't be shown again.

delivery.sent: Invite created and emailed. You can also copy the link now.
delivery.outbox: Invite created. This server doesn't send email, so copy the link and share it yourself. It's also in the outbox below.
delivery.failed: Invite created, but the email could not be sent. Copy the link and share it yourself. It's also in the outbox below.

copyManually: Couldn't copy automatically. The link is selected: press Ctrl+C (or Cmd+C) to copy it.
smtpOn: This server sends email over SMTP. Only messages that failed to send are kept here.
smtpOff: This server doesn't send email. Password reset and invite messages wait here: copy a link and send it to the person yourself.
